contracts.title: Meteor Trail Triangulator
contracts.player_scenario: Record a fictional meteor from two viewpoints and infer a safe exploration zone
contracts.source_rule: Two distinct timed observations needed; discovered zone contains finite clues
contracts.negative_case: Repeating one viewpoint cannot triangulate a reward
domain_invariants: At least two distinct vantage IDs and observation minutes from the same event epoch
Bearings differ and clue claims never exceed finite clue count
No discovery reward from repeated vantage point
